main.description: A character's mechanical state in ONE campaign: structured traits assembled from the player's prompt replies in that campaign. Campaign-scoped on purpose, so the same character can hold different mechanics in two concurrent campaigns. Written into the campaign's space (authority: Bardcast's DID, skey: the campaign), never into the player's own repo. Derived state, regenerated as more replies arrive. The rkey is the player's DID, so a campaign holds one current sheet per player.

campaign.description: The campaign this sheet belongs to. Redundant with the space the record lives in; kept so the record stands on its own when read out of context.

character.description: AT-URI of the character.profile in the player's repo. The durable identity this sheet is one campaign's view of.

traits.description: Named traits (ability scores, virtues, flaws, skills) inferred from replies.

sourceReplies.description: AT-URIs of the Antiphony reply records this sheet was derived from (provenance). Replies to this campaign's prompts only.

value.description: Free-form value (a number, a tag, or a phrase) so the same shape works for D&D stats and freeform systems.

confidence.description: How strongly the replies support this trait. Feeds the readiness gate.
